proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 1291 article gives Malayalam karayuka to cry, lament, neigh, caw, caterwaul; karaccil weeping, crying, lamentation; cry of certain animals or birds; karaḷuka to mumble; karaḷca mumbling.. The Malayalam survey form karaññu “cry” is proposed within this article family.
